newsitem.title: USA: Credit Lyonnais unit appoints co-head.
newsitem.headline: Credit Lyonnais unit appoints co-head.

text.p: Credit Lyonnais Securities, a wholly owned subsidiary of Paris-based Credit Lyonnais, said on Monday that it had appointment Jeffrey Posner as a managing director and co-head of U.S. equity capital markets.

In tandem with Pierre Lapomme, Posner will be responsible for managing the capital raising process in equity transactions for the unit and the coordination of research and distribution of U.S. equities, CLS said in a statement.
Prior to joining CLS on June 2, Posner served as director of capital markets at privately held investment banking firm Vector Securities International Inc, it added.
Credit Lyonnais is a worldwide financial institution with assets of roughly $311 billion.
